findings.reason: The component range 1..n is not reconciled with the 4D 0..3 convention, and the definition uses functions on U while both transformation lemmas evaluate them at coordinate tuples such as x(y; define the reindexing and coordinate representatives explicitly.

The draft def-time-orientation-and-future-causal-sets claims topology is basis-independent, but its cited cone lemma proves this only for orthonormal bases; this definition relies on the resulting component claims, so supply the general finite-dimensional basis-change argument locally.
The displayed contraction δ^c_b g^{ab} equals g^{ab}, not δ^a_b; remove this false duplicate or replace it with the correct inverse-matrix identity.

The item assigns units to τ, U, R, Ric and S before defining them; their suppliers def-gr-timelike-worldline-and-proper-time (GR02) and def-gr-curvature-tensor-and-derived-tensors (GR04) are later, Γ lacks def-christoffel-symbols-of-an-affine-connection, and def-gr-stress-energy-tensor-field uses the forward T convention.
The formula, facts and proof use indices and sums 1..4 although the GR four-dimensional convention is 0..3; align them with the declared index system.

All orthonormal T_AB components are assigned J/m³, yet off-diagonal entries are described as energy flux and momentum density without c conversions or requiring future-directed e_0; define the observer readings and SI factors.

The postulate says g's curvature represents gravity without identifying the connection or defining curvature; the later GR03/04 suppliers thm-gr-nondegenerate-levi-civita-and-tensor-derivative and def-gr-curvature-tensor-and-derived-tensors leave an unresolved definition-order obligation.

The cited inverse-function theorem proves only a local diffeomorphism; step 2.1 also needs the global open-image and smooth-inverse consequence for the injective map, which should be derived by openness and gluing the local inverses.
The remark says WEC, NEC and DEC are unordered, but the stated definitions give WEC ⇒ NEC by a timelike limit and DEC ⇒ WEC; replace the false assertion with the actual implication scope.

This read-only consumer assumes an SI flux-restoration rule from def-gr-si-unit-and-coordinate-conventions that the supplier does not state; any repair to its public unit reading is outside batch 65 and needs owner direction.
